correctness.rationale: For fixed coprime integers 2<=r<s, unique-power factorization makes the return partition exactly e^(-p)(D_r+D_s-D_(rs)). Kac/Abramov plus Gibbs relative entropy give a uniquely attained stationary renewal variational formula. Euler summation with two differentiated error bounds gives D_k=a_k p^(-1/k)-1/2+O(p^(1/k)); expansion of the strictly convex saddle p=q rho gives both the quadratic Legendre correction and duplicate-power term with an o(rho^min(2alpha,beta)) remainder. beta-2alpha=(2r-s-1)/(rs) yields the trichotomy. The extracted standalone stdlib checker passed 24 saddle/entropy tests, eight intersection checks, and eight critical-order comparisons; these are supporting tests, not a substitute for the analytic proof. Endpoints, noncoprime exponents and uniformity are excluded.

value.rationale: The union of natural perfect-power gap families changes the first sparse-marker entropy correction, while simultaneous union overlap and entropy saddle feedback compete at a sharp complete arithmetic boundary s=2r-1. The theorem classifies every coprime exponent pair (not an arbitrary numerical instance) and resolves the exact first two nontrivial scales, including the genuine resonance cases such as (2,3). It provides motivated invariant-entropy benchmarks for renewal symbolic dynamics. It does not claim that classical Gibbs inducing itself is novel.
